SCE.S:242054: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:242120: Came to meet his uncle here. The uncle taught him games as a boy.
SCE.S:2421EC: In town for a reunion. Has a son in college and a daughter in high school. Won't see them again.
SCE.S:2422B8: "This City is sealed off! No one's noticed! Everyone's going mad! They're all enemies!"
SCE.S:242384: Ex-tax accountant posing as a cop. Guards the City's gate, deciding who leaves and who enters.
SCE.S:242450: The fourth agent, sent in secret by top officials who sensed the City's "anomaly." A war hero.
SCE.S:24251C: Crowds once used this station daily. Since the highway opened, few come. He feels lonely.
SCE.S:25BB44: {6}Excuse me... Is this your first time in this town? ...I'm with the police. A highly contagious disease is spreading, you see. For your safety, we'd like you to stay at the {7}hotel{6} we've arranged. Oh? You live here? ...My apologies.
SCE.S:25BDD8: ...Something's off. I came to pick up my uncle, but the train schedule is a total mess.
SCE.S:25BE9C: A police officer told me to go to the {7}hotel{2}. Someone was supposed to come get me, but nobody has... I can't reach anyone. What should I do?
SCE.S:25BFB4: {6}For everyone's safety, we're guiding people to the {7}hotel{6}.
SCE.S:25C054: Something's strange today. Very few passengers are boarding at this station.
SCE.S:25E344: {6}You're from here, aren't you? ...Traveling somewhere? A bomb attack on the tracks just happened between here and the next town. All lines are down. I'm with the police. If you see anyone suspicious, will you report it?
SCE.S:25E538: You're the newspaper's resident reporter, right? Good, we didn't miss each other. It wasn't easy getting here. I chartered a fishing boat in the next town and came ashore at dawn. ...Forgive me. Call me {7}Kouda{2}. I'll be imposing on you during my stay. Right away, then: any good {7}hotel{2}? ...... Right near your office? That sounds convenient.
SCE.S:25E7B0: I didn't sleep much last night. I'll rest at the {7}hotel{2} you recommended. Come to my room at the {7}hotel{2} later.
SCE.S:25E938: I heard there was a bomb attack? Is my uncle all right? I called his house, and my aunt says he did board a train, but... he's missing.
SCE.S:25EA44: This is a problem. I have to get to the next town today... The expressway is closed, so I thought I'd take the train.
SCE.S:25EB20: {6}That suspicious man standing over there. Do you know him?
SCE.S:25EBBC: I'll give you the details in my room at the {7}hotel{2}. There are shady characters around here.
SCE.S:25EC70: {6}There was a bomb attack... At present there's no prospect of restoring service on either line.
SCE.S:260B44: {6}All trains are suspended. You've been here before. ...So you're from the newspaper. You'd better not stick your nose into too many things, for your own good!
SCE.S:260D68: Hey! Do you know anything? We're trapped in this town.
SCE.S:260E10: {6}I told you to "stop" prying where you shouldn't!
SCE.S:260EFC: {6}We apologize. Service is suspended in both directions. We're working on restoration, but there's no prospect yet.
SCE.S:2633E0: You came. A lot has happened... but I'm glad I got to see you. I'll sort out my affairs and come back to town. The public hospital needs hands, too. I'm sure we'll meet again soon!
SCE.S:2635D4: I really do mean to come back soon. But until then... goodbye.
SCE.S:2637E4: We apologize for the inconvenience. We've finally started a temporary service of two trains a day.
SCE.S:265B10: {6}A freight train will depart as soon as preparations are done. It's set to carry "seeds" for 200,000 people.
SCE.S:265BD0: {6}A plan is under way to "change" the neighboring towns for the better. We've prepared "seeds" for mind-and-body change for about 200,000 people.
